title: Peak and Trough

story.briefing: The sensor array has been logging for years. Somewhere in that log is the spread that broke the regulator — find how far apart the extremes sit.
story.success: Spread identified. The regulator recalibrates itself.

description: Given a non-empty array of integers, return the difference between the largest and the smallest value in it.
hints: You need two facts about the array, and a single pass can collect both.
Starting your "smallest so far" at 0 breaks on all-positive arrays. Seed both trackers from the first element instead.
Set both min and max to readings[0], walk the rest of the array updating each, then return max - min.
